get.description: Returns every RechargeInfo row with RechargeStatus = 1 as a bare JSON array. No session is read; the cookie session middleware still wraps the scope but never rejects. No pagination, no ordering clause (SQL Server row order), no caching (the generic cache is a TODO). The `type` of each package decides which payment method POST /transaction/{id} will use.

get.summary: Read one recharge package by ID
get.description: Returns the RechargeInfo row regardless of its status (inactive packages are readable here). A nil UUID (all zeroes) returns 400. A missing row is reported as 500, not 404, because the DB layer returns an error that the handler maps to 500.

post.summary: Start a recharge purchase for one package
post.description:
Requires a signed-in user session whose profile has is_verified = true. Loads the RechargeInfo by path ID, then dispatches on RechargeInfo.type:

- 1 GCash: body REQUIRED, `{"type":"gcash",...}`. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 1) with reference code and optional proof image; an administrator approves it later.
- 2 PayPal: body MUST BE ABSENT. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 2), creates a PayPal order (USD, intent CAPTURE, invoice_id = transaction UUID) and returns the PayPal approval URL. The PayPal webhook settles it.
- 3 Wise: body REQUIRED, `{"type":"wise",...}`. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 3) with reference code; an administrator approves it later.
- 4 PayMongo: body MUST BE ABSENT. Inserts a pending WebTransaction (type 4), creates a PayMongo checkout session (PHP centavos, card + gcash, metadata.transaction_id = transaction UUID) and returns its checkout URL as approval_url. The PayMongo webhook settles it.

The body extractor is Option<Json<TransactionPayload>>: an unparseable, wrong-content-type or oversized (>2 MiB actix default) body is silently treated as absent. Sending a body to a PayPal/PayMongo package, or the wrong tag for the package type, returns 400 'Invalid transaction data'. A Discord notification is spawned after GCash/Wise inserts. Points are credited only when the transaction status later becomes 1 (database trigger trg_AddWebPoints).

requestBody.description: Required for GCash (type 1) and Wise (type 3) packages; must be omitted for PayPal (type 2) and PayMongo (type 4).

gcash_with_proof.summary: GCash package (type 1) with base64 proof image

200.description: Shape depends on the package type: TransactionAccepted for GCash/Wise, PayPalApproval for PayPal, PayMongoCheckoutCreated for PayMongo.

400.description: Body validation failed (`error` key: 'Reference number cannot be empty', 'Proof image is too large', 'Invalid image format'), body missing for GCash/Wise (`message`: 'Missing transaction data'), or body/type mismatch (`message`: 'Invalid transaction data'). All variants include recharge_info.

403.description: Session user has not verified their email.

example.message: Email verification required to use this feature

404.description: Recharge package not found, nil UUID, or any DB error while loading it (all collapse to the same response). A non-UUID path segment returns actix's plain-text 404 instead.

422.description: PayPal/PayMongo only: inserting the pending WebTransaction failed.

500.description: No session (`message`: 'No session found' — not 401), GCash/Wise insert failure (`message`: 'Error processing request' + recharge_info; this includes a proof_image that is not plain base64), PayPal order build/create failure (`error` + `details`), PayPal approval link missing (`error`), or PayMongo API failure (`message` + recharge_info).

get.description: Returns GatewayInfo rows with GatewayStatus = 1 (filtered in Rust after SELECT *). Gateways are the account details (name, number, QR/logo image) a player pays into for manual methods such as GCash. Rows whose GatewayImage is NULL are silently skipped by the row parser.

get.summary: List the signed-in user's own transactions
get.description: Requires a user session. Loads every WebTransaction of session.user_num ordered by TransactionTime DESC, filters in memory by `status` and `category` (= transaction type), then paginates in memory. `search`, `start_date`, `end_date` are accepted but ignored. Results are cached per (user_num, page, limit) for 30 seconds; the cache stores the unfiltered list, so filter changes apply immediately but newly created transactions can take up to 30 s to appear.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Keep only this transaction type (payment method).

200.description: One page of the user's transactions.

UserSessionCookie.name: YXGames
UserSessionCookie.description: actix-session CookieSessionStore cookie. Name comes from env COOKIE_NAME (YXGames in the reviewed .env). Private (encrypted) content, HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure unless WEB_DOMAIN ends with .local, Domain = WEB_DOMAIN. Set by the user login endpoint (/api/v1/auth, outside this contract); the session key `user_data` holds a ProfileData. Browsers must send credentials (fetch credentials: 'include'). A missing/expired session makes the handler return 500 {"message":"No session found"}.

PaymentsRechargeId.name: id
PaymentsRechargeId.description: RechargeInfo.id (RechargeID). A value that is not a UUID fails path extraction with actix's plain-text 404.

PaymentsPage.name: page
PaymentsPage.description: 1-based page. page=0 underflows `page - 1`: panic in debug builds (overflow-checks), empty `data` in release builds.

PaymentsLimit.name: limit
PaymentsLimit.description: Page size; values above 100 are clamped to 100.

PaymentsFetchFailed.description: Database failure (or, for the by-ID route, row not found).

PaymentsPathNotParsed.description: Path segment is not a UUID; actix path extractor returns plain text.

PaymentsBadQuery.description: A query value has the wrong type (e.g. page=abc); actix query extractor returns plain text.

examples: Query deserialize error: invalid digit found in string

TransactionType.description: Payment method. 1 = GCash (manual, proof + reference, admin approval), 2 = PayPal (redirect, webhook settlement, USD), 3 = Wise (manual, reference, admin approval), 4 = PayMongo (redirect, webhook settlement, PHP). Used by RechargeInfo.type, AddRechargeInfo.type and WebTransactionResponse.transaction_type. Stored as SMALLINT; there is no Rust enum, only these literal values in the dispatch match.

TransactionStatus.description: 0 = Pending (DB default on insert), 1 = Approved (trigger trg_AddWebPoints adds TransactionAmount to WebUser.WebPoints on the 0→1 change), 2 = Declined/Cancelled. Only Pending rows can change status.

RecordStatus.description: Visibility flag for RechargeInfo and GatewayInfo rows. 1 = active (returned by the player endpoints). Any other value hides the row from players; the code assigns no other meaning.

amount.description: RechargeAmount: real-money price. Currency is implied by type: PayPal charges USD, PayMongo charges PHP (amount × 100 centavos); GCash/Wise are paid manually.

discount.description: RechargeDiscount (MONEY; the table script declares NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, so 0.0 is the usual 'no discount' value). Display-only; never applied to the charged amount. Always present; null only if the live column allows NULL.

points.description: RechargePoints: R-Coin (web points) credited on approval.

GatewayInfo.description: Account details a player pays into for a manual method (table GatewayInfo).

provider.description: GatewayProvider. No mapping exists in code or SQL; treat as an opaque code (frontends conventionally reuse TransactionType values).

image.description: GatewayImage bytes as standard base64 (no data: prefix), e.g. a QR code.

WebTransactionResponse.description: One purchase attempt (table WebTransaction), with the proof image re-encoded to base64.

transaction_id.description: TransactionID. Also the PayPal invoice_id and PayMongo metadata.transaction_id / reference_number.

transaction_time.description: TransactionTime (DB DATETIME, interpreted in the API server's local timezone) serialized RFC 3339 with offset.

transaction_amount.description: TransactionAmount = RechargeInfo.points (R-Coin to credit). Despite the name this is NOT money.

proof_image.description: ProofImage bytes as standard base64, no data: prefix. GCash only.

admin_remarks.description: AdminRemarks. No endpoint in this contract writes it.

TransactionPage.description: Paginated transaction list with computed total_pages (json! macro, no Rust struct).

limit.description: Effective page size after clamping to 100.

total_pages.description: ceil(total_items / limit); 1 when there are no items.

reference_number.description: GCash reference number. Must be non-blank after trim. Stored in RefferenceCode NVARCHAR(50): longer values fail the insert (500). Not checked for uniqueness (the duplicate check is commented out).

proof_image.description: Receipt screenshot as plain standard base64 WITHOUT a data: prefix. Validation lets a data:image... string through, but the DB layer then fails to decode it and the request returns 500. Max 5,000,000 characters by validation; the actix JSON limit (2 MiB) applies first.

reference_number.description: Wise transfer reference. Must be non-blank after trim. Stored in RefferenceCode NVARCHAR(50).

TransactionPayload.description: Serde internally tagged enum: #[serde(tag = "type", rename_all = "lowercase")]. The variant fields sit next to `type` at the top level.

TransactionAccepted.description: GCash/Wise success (json! macro). The created transaction ID is NOT returned.

data.description: The submitted GCashTransaction or WiseTransaction echoed back (without the `type` tag). GCash echoes proof_image (null when omitted).

PayPalApproval.description: PayPal success (json! macro). Redirect the browser to approval_url. PayPal returns the buyer to env PAYPAL_RETURN_URL / PAYPAL_CANCEL_URL.

approval_url.description: PayPal order link with rel = approve.

PayMongoCheckoutCreated.description: PayMongo success (json! macro). Redirect the browser to approval_url. PayMongo returns the buyer to env PAYMONGO_SUCCESS_URL / PAYMONGO_CANCEL_URL.

examples.message: Email verification required to use this feature

details.description: PayPal failures only: Debug/Display text of the underlying error.
